# Menu: `jl-menu`

A list of actions that opens from a button, driven by the pointer or entirely by the keyboard.

- Class `JlMenu`, a molecule: `import { JlMenu } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/menu

A list of actions that opens from its trigger: put any button in slot="trigger". It opens on a press,
or with ArrowDown (ArrowUp starts from the end), and the focus goes to the first item.

In the menu, the arrows move, Home and End jump to the ends, a letter jumps to the next item that starts with it, and
Enter or Space chooses. Choosing closes the menu, sends the focus back to the trigger and fires select with the item's
value; Escape closes it the same way, Tab closes it and moves on. Items are { value, label, icon?, shortcut?,
description?, danger?, disabled? }, with { divider: true } for a line and { heading } for a title over the items that
follow it.

showAt(x, y) opens the menu at a point of the window instead, with no trigger: the menu of a table's row or a tree's
item, where a right click asked for it (their press event gives the point). It needs a label, and gives the focus
back to what had it when it closes. Keep the same actions within reach of a button too: not everyone can ask for a
menu with a right click.

## Use

```ts
import { JlButton, JlMenu } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlMenu
  items={[{"icon":"pencil","label":"Rename","shortcut":"F2","value":"rename"},{"icon":"copy","label":"Duplicate","shortcut":"⌘D","value":"duplicate"},{"icon":"download","label":"Download","value":"download"},{"icon":"share","label":"Share","value":"share"},{"divider":true},{"danger":true,"icon":"trash","label":"Delete","shortcut":"⌫","value":"delete"}]}
  placement="bottom-start"
>
  <JlButton slot="trigger" iconEnd="chevron-down" label="Actions" />
</JlMenu>
```

```html
<jl-menu
  items='[{"icon":"pencil","label":"Rename","shortcut":"F2","value":"rename"},{"icon":"copy","label":"Duplicate","shortcut":"⌘D","value":"duplicate"},{"icon":"download","label":"Download","value":"download"},{"icon":"share","label":"Share","value":"share"},{"divider":true},{"danger":true,"icon":"trash","label":"Delete","shortcut":"⌫","value":"delete"}]'
  placement="bottom-start"
>
  <jl-button slot="trigger" icon-end="chevron-down" label="Actions"></jl-button>
</jl-menu>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `items` (attribute `items`): `MenuItem<Value>[]`, default `[]`. The items: { value, label, icon?, shortcut?, description?, danger?, disabled? }, { divider: true } or { heading }.
- `placement` (attribute `placement`): `Placement`, default `'bottom-start'`. The side of the trigger the menu goes on, and where along it.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The menu’s name for screen readers; the trigger names it otherwise.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `select` (`onSelect` in JSX), detail `Value`: People chose an item; the detail is its value.
- `open` (`onOpen` in JSX), detail `undefined`: The menu opened.
- `close` (`onClose` in JSX), detail `undefined`: The menu closed.

## Slots

- `trigger`: The button that opens the menu.

## Methods

- `show(): void`: Opens the menu and focuses its first item.
- `showAt(x: number, y: number): void`: Opens the menu at a point of the window, such as a press's event.clientX and event.clientY, and focuses its first item: its corner goes there, above the point when there is no room under it. No trigger is needed; the focus goes back to what had it when the menu closes.
- `hide(): void`: Closes the menu.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The floating list of items.

## Typing

Typed by its values, JlMenu<'rename' | 'duplicate' | 'delete'> takes actions of those values only, and gives select one of them. A page then handles them with a Record of one handler per action, which TypeScript refuses while one is missing.

```ts
import type { JlMenu } from '@syware/jlib';

type FileAction = 'rename' | 'duplicate' | 'delete';

// One handler per action: TypeScript refuses this record while an action is missing.
const ACTIONS: Record<FileAction, () => void> = {
  delete: deleteFile,
  duplicate: duplicateFile,
  rename: renameFile,
};

const menu = document.querySelector<JlMenu<FileAction>>('jl-menu.file');
menu?.items.set([
  { icon: 'pencil', label: 'Rename', value: 'rename' },
  { icon: 'copy', label: 'Duplicate', value: 'duplicate' },
  { divider: true },
  { danger: true, icon: 'trash', label: 'Delete', value: 'delete' },
]);
// @ts-expect-error: 'share' is not an action of the menu
menu?.items.set([{ label: 'Share', value: 'share' }]);
menu?.events.register('select', (action) => ACTIONS[action]());
```

```tsx
import { Jadis } from '@jadis/core';
import { JlButton, JlMenu } from '@syware/jlib';

import type { MenuItem } from '@syware/jlib';

type FileAction = 'rename' | 'duplicate' | 'delete';

const FILE_ACTIONS: MenuItem<FileAction>[] = [
  { icon: 'pencil', label: 'Rename', value: 'rename' },
  { icon: 'copy', label: 'Duplicate', value: 'duplicate' },
  { divider: true },
  { danger: true, icon: 'trash', label: 'Delete', value: 'delete' },
];

// One handler per action: TypeScript refuses this record while an action is missing.
const ACTIONS: Record<FileAction, () => void> = {
  delete: deleteFile,
  duplicate: duplicateFile,
  rename: renameFile,
};

export class FileRow extends Jadis {
  static readonly selector = 'file-row';

  templateHtml(): Node {
    return (
      <JlMenu<FileAction> label="File actions" items={FILE_ACTIONS} onSelect={(action) => ACTIONS[action]()}>
        <JlButton slot="trigger" variant="ghost" size="sm" icon="ellipsis" hint="More" />
      </JlMenu>
    );
  }
}

FileRow.register();
```

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Row actions

An ellipsis button with the actions of a row, the destructive one last and in red.

```html
<div class="row">
  <span>quarterly-report.pdf</span>
  <jl-menu class="demo-file" label="File actions" placement="bottom-end" items='[{"icon":"pencil","label":"Rename","shortcut":"F2","value":"rename"},{"icon":"copy","label":"Duplicate","shortcut":"⌘D","value":"duplicate"},{"icon":"download","label":"Download","value":"download"},{"icon":"share","label":"Share","value":"share"},{"divider":true},{"danger":true,"icon":"trash","label":"Delete","shortcut":"⌫","value":"delete"}]'>
    <jl-button slot="trigger" variant="ghost" icon="ellipsis" hint="More actions"></jl-button>
  </jl-menu>
  <span class="muted demo-chosen">Choose an action</span>
</div>
```

```js
const chosen = root.querySelector('.demo-chosen');
root.querySelector('jl-menu').events.register('select', (value) => {
  chosen.textContent = `Chose: ${value}`;
});
```

### Groups and descriptions

Headings over groups of items, a description under an item, and a disabled item.

```html
<jl-menu items='[{"heading":"Account"},{"icon":"user","label":"Profile","value":"profile"},{"icon":"settings","label":"Settings","value":"settings"},{"description":"Upgrade to share with your whole team","icon":"sparkles","label":"Plans","value":"plans"},{"divider":true},{"heading":"Workspace"},{"icon":"users","label":"Members","value":"members"},{"disabled":true,"icon":"credit-card","label":"Billing","value":"billing"},{"divider":true},{"icon":"log-out","label":"Sign out","value":"sign-out"}]'>
  <jl-button slot="trigger" icon="user" icon-end="chevron-down" label="Ada Lovelace"></jl-button>
</jl-menu>
```

### Any trigger

The trigger can be any button, here a native one.

```html
<jl-menu items='[{"value":"newest","label":"Newest first"},{"value":"oldest","label":"Oldest first"},{"value":"popular","label":"Most popular"}]'>
  <button slot="trigger" type="button">Sort by</button>
</jl-menu>
```

### Where the pointer is

showAt(x, y) opens the menu where the pointer is: here on a right click in the frame (the keyboard's menu key asks for it too, with the focus in it). The menu has no trigger, so its label names it.

```html
<div class="stack">
  <div class="demo-zone" tabindex="0" style="padding: 32px; border: 1px dashed var(--jl-line-strong); border-radius: var(--jl-radius); text-align: center">
    Right-click in this frame
  </div>
  <jl-menu class="demo-context" label="Frame actions" items='[{"icon":"pencil","label":"Rename","shortcut":"F2","value":"rename"},{"icon":"copy","label":"Duplicate","shortcut":"⌘D","value":"duplicate"},{"icon":"download","label":"Download","value":"download"},{"icon":"share","label":"Share","value":"share"},{"divider":true},{"danger":true,"icon":"trash","label":"Delete","shortcut":"⌫","value":"delete"}]'></jl-menu>
  <span class="muted demo-context-chosen">Choose an action</span>
</div>
```

```js
const menu = root.querySelector('jl-menu.demo-context');
root.querySelector('.demo-zone').addEventListener('contextmenu', (event) => {
  event.preventDefault(); // the browser's menu stays away
  menu.showAt(event.clientX, event.clientY);
});
```
